q: Find the next number in the series: 7, 10, 16, 28, 52, ?
The differences double each time: 3, 6, 12, 24, then 48. So 52 + 48 = 100.
If MARGAO is written as NBSHBP in a certain code, how is PANAJI written in that code?
Each letter moves one place forward: P-Q, A-B, N-O, A-B, J-K, I-J.
D and E are a married couple, and D is the husband. A and B are their children. A is B's brother, and B is the mother of C. How is C related to E?
E is the mother of B, and B is the mother of C, so C is E's grandchild. Nothing in the statement tells us whether C is male or female.
Ramesh walks 9 km towards the north, turns right and walks 12 km. How far is he from his starting point in a straight line?
The two legs are at right angles, so the distance is the hypotenuse: the square root of 81 + 144 = 225, which is 15 km.
Statements: All files are records. Some records are confidential documents. Conclusions: I. Some files are confidential documents. II. Some confidential documents are records.
II is the second statement turned around, so it follows. I does not: the confidential records need not be files.

Five officers P, Q, R, S and T sit in a row facing north. R sits exactly in the middle. P sits to the immediate left of R. T does not sit at either end. Q does not sit next to P. Who sits at the extreme right end?
R is third and P second. T is not at an end, so T is fourth. Q cannot sit next to P, so Q is fifth and S is first. The order is S, P, R, T, Q.

X, Y and Z start a firm with ₹90,000, ₹1,20,000 and ₹1,50,000. X, the managing partner, gets an allowance of ₹4,000 a month. Z's share of the divisible profit is guaranteed to be at least ₹1,15,000, any shortfall being borne by Y alone. If the annual profit before X's allowance is ₹2,88,000, what does Y finally receive?
Allowance 48,000; divisible 2,40,000 in 3:4:5 gives 60,000 / 80,000 / 1,00,000. Z is 15,000 short, which Y pays: 80,000 − 15,000 = 65,000. GPSC CBRT, Sep 2026.
Two trains P and Q start at the same time from X and Y towards each other. After meeting, P takes 4 hours to reach Y and Q takes 9 hours to reach X. If P runs at 72 km/h, what is the distance XY?
Speeds are in the ratio √9 : √4 = 3 : 2, so Q = 48 km/h. They meet after √(4 × 9) = 6 h; P travels 6 + 4 = 10 h × 72 = 720 km. GPSC CBRT, Sep 2026.

P provides premises (₹6,00,000); Q and R put in ₹3,00,000 and ₹5,00,000 cash. P gets rent of ₹5,000 a month; Q and R get 10% interest on capital; the rest is shared 3 : 2 : 5. If Q's total earning is ₹70,000, what was the gross profit?
Q's interest 30,000, so his share is 40,000 = 2/10 of the remainder: 2,00,000. Add R's interest 50,000, Q's 30,000 and rent 60,000: 3,40,000. GPSC CBRT, Sep 2026.
Find the next letter in the series: A, C, F, J, O, ?
The gaps grow by one each time: +2, +3, +4, +5, then +6. O is the 15th letter, so the next is the 21st, U.
Mamlatdar is to Taluka as Collector is to:
A Mamlatdar heads the revenue administration of a taluka; a Collector heads that of a district.
Each letter is given its position in the alphabet (A = 1, B = 2, and so on) and a word's value is the sum of its letters, so GOA = 7 + 15 + 1 = 23. What is the value of PANAJI?
Pointing to a woman, Rohan said, "She is the only daughter of my mother's father." How is the woman related to Rohan?
His mother's father is his maternal grandfather. That man's only daughter is Rohan's mother.
Priya is facing east. She turns 90 degrees clockwise, then 180 degrees, then 90 degrees anticlockwise. Which direction is she facing now?
East, then clockwise to south, then about-turn to north, then anticlockwise to west.
In a group of 60 candidates, 35 know Konkani, 30 know Marathi and 10 know neither language. How many know both?
50 candidates know at least one language. 35 + 30 - 50 = 15 know both.
Milk and water are mixed in the ratio 7 : 3. How much water must be added to 10 litres of the mixture to make the ratio 7 : 5?
10 L has 7 L milk and 3 L water. For 7 : 5 water must be 5 L: add 2 L. GPSC CBRT, Jan 2026.
Two ships on opposite sides of a 100 m lighthouse see its top at elevations of 30° and 45°. How far apart are the ships?
Distances are 100√3 ≈ 173 m and 100 m; on opposite sides they add to about 273 m. GPSC CBRT, Sep 2025.
Statement: “Management should implement remote work to improve productivity.” Which assumption is implicit?
The advice only makes sense if remote work does raise productivity. GPSC CBRT, Jan 2026.
Find the odd set of letters:
F6 I9 K11, D4 G7 I9, M13 P16 R18 all go +3, +2. K11 N14 D4 breaks it. GPSC CBRT, Sep 2026.
Find the next number in the series: 5, 11, 23, 47, 95, ?
Each term is double the previous one plus 1: 95 x 2 + 1 = 191.
If ROAD is written as URDG in a certain code, how is FORT written?
Each letter moves three places forward: F-I, O-R, R-U, T-W.
Odometer is to distance as barometer is to:
An odometer measures distance travelled; a barometer measures atmospheric pressure.
A is B's sister. C is B's mother. D is C's father. How is A related to D?
A is the daughter of C, and C is the daughter of D, so A is D's granddaughter.
A man walks 4 km south, turns left and walks 3 km, then turns left again and walks 8 km. How far and in which direction is he from his starting point?
He ends 3 km east and 4 km north of the start. The straight-line distance is 5 km, to the north-east.
Ravi is 12th from the top and 19th from the bottom in his class. How many students are there in the class?
Total = 12 + 19 - 1 = 30, which is not among options A to D.
Sam bought 20 dozen toys at ₹375 a dozen and sold each toy for ₹33. What was his profit per cent?
Cost per toy 375 ÷ 12 = 31.25; profit 1.75; 1.75 ÷ 31.25 = 5.6%. GPSC CBRT, Sep 2025.
60% of a school's students are boys. 25% of the boys and 30% of the girls hold scholarships. What per cent of all students hold scholarships?
Find the sum of the first 30 even natural numbers.
Find the wrong number in the series: 582, 605, 588, 611, 634, 617, 600
The pattern is +23, −17 by turns: 611 − 17 = 594, not 634. GPSC CBRT, Sep 2026.
Find the next number in the series: 2, 5, 10, 17, 26, ?
The terms are 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 squared plus 1. The next is 6 squared plus 1 = 37.
If TABLE is written as UBCMF in a certain code, how is CHAIR written?
Each letter moves one place forward: C-D, H-I, A-B, I-J, R-S.
Rice, wheat and maize are cereal grains. Cotton is a fibre crop.
Pointing to a boy, Sunita said, 'He is the son of my husband's only sister.' How is the boy related to Sunita?
The son of her husband's sister is her nephew.
One morning just after sunrise, Vikram stood facing a pole. The shadow of the pole fell exactly to his right. Which direction was he facing?
After sunrise shadows fall to the west. If west is to his right, he is facing south.

Six friends A, B, C, D, E and F sit in a row facing north. C is at the extreme left. A is third from the right end. B is to the immediate right of A. D sits next to both C and E. Who is at the extreme right?
C is first, A fourth and B fifth. D must be second with E third, which leaves the sixth seat for F.
Ayesha's father was 38 when she was born; her mother was 36 when her brother, four years younger than Ayesha, was born. What is the difference between the parents' ages?
When Ayesha was born her mother was 36 − 4 = 32 and her father 38: a gap of 6 years. GPSC CBRT, Sep 2025.
If 15 men complete a work in 24 days, how many men will complete the same work in 10 days?
A train 130 m long at 45 km/h crosses a bridge in 30 seconds. How long is the bridge?
Find the next number in the series: 3, 6, 18, 72, 360, ?
If A = 2, B = 4, C = 6 and so on, what is the value of G + O + A?
Book is to library as painting is to:
Books are kept and shown in a library; paintings in a gallery.
The first three are four-sided figures. A triangle has three sides.
X and Y are husband and wife. Z is their daughter and W is their son. V is W's son. How is X related to V?
X is the father of W, and W is the father of V, so X is V's grandfather.
A man leaves his house, walks 10 m east, turns right and walks 5 m, then turns right again and walks 10 m. Where is he in relation to his house?
He goes 10 m east, 5 m south and 10 m back west, ending 5 m south of the house.
The average age of 30 students is 15 years. Including the teacher, the average rises by 1. What is the teacher's age?
Find the compound interest on ₹1,600 at 10% a year for 2 years, compounded annually.
Four boxes each hold the same number of sweets and carry these labels: 'Five or Six', 'Seven or Eight', 'Six or Seven', 'Seven or Five'. Only one label is correct. How many sweets are in each box?
Five, six and seven each make two labels true. Eight makes only 'Seven or Eight' true. GPSC CBRT, Jun 2025.
The others are a substance and what holds it; a nib is part of a pen. GPSC CBRT, Sep 2026.
Find the next number in the series: 100, 96, 88, 76, 60, ?
Which letter is eighth to the right of the fifteenth letter from the left in the English alphabet?
The fifteenth letter is O. Eight places on is the twenty-third letter, W.
In a certain code PEN is written as QGQ. How is INK written in that code?
The letters move forward by 1, 2 and 3 places: I-J, N-P, K-N.
42 is 6 x 7. In the same way 8 x 9 = 72.
Introducing a man, a woman said, 'His wife is the only daughter of my father.' How is the man related to the woman?
The only daughter of her father is the woman herself, so the man is her husband.
The Collectorate is due north of the bus stand. The court is due east of the Collectorate. In which direction is the bus stand from the court?
From the court, the bus stand lies to the west and to the south, that is, south-west.
The sum of the ages of a father and his son is 60 years. The father is 40 years older than the son. What are their ages?
If A = 1, B = 2, …, Z = 26, what is the sum of the letters in COMPUTER?
At what time between 3 and 4 o’clock will the hands of a clock be at right angles (after 3:00)?
5.5M − 90 = 90, so M = 32 8/11: about 3:32. GPSC CBRT, Feb 2026.
Find the next number in the series: 2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13, ?
These are the prime numbers in order. The next prime after 13 is 17.
Find the next term in the series: AZ, BY, CX, DW, ?
The first letter moves forward and the second moves backward: E and V.
In a certain code each letter is replaced by the letter in the same position counted from the other end of the alphabet, so GOA becomes TLZ. How is INDIA written?
121, 144 and 169 are the squares of 11, 12 and 13. 200 is not a perfect square.
Q is the brother of P. R is the daughter of P. S is the sister of Q. T is the mother of S. How is T related to R?
P, Q and S are siblings and T is their mother. R is P's daughter, so T is R's grandmother.
A clock shows 4:30. It is placed so that the minute hand points east. In which direction does the hour hand point?
At 4:30 the minute hand is at 6. If 6 points east, then 3 points north, and the hour hand, between 4 and 5, points north-east.
If A = 1, B = 2, …, Z = 26, what is the sum of the letters in EXAMINATION?
5+24+1+13+9+14+1+20+9+15+14 = 125, which is not listed. GPSC's printed key said 150; the sum is 125, so E. GPSC CBRT, Jun 2025.
The sum of the present ages of a father and son is 60. Six years ago the father was five times as old as the son. What will the son's age be after 6 years?
f + s = 60 and f − 6 = 5(s − 6), so s = 14 now and 20 in six years. GPSC CBRT, Jun 2025.
Employees and managers are in the ratio 7 : 3. 70% of employees and 30% of managers eat in the canteen. What per cent of the workforce eats in the canteen?
The HCF of two numbers is 12 and their LCM is 924. If one number is 132, find the other.
Product = HCF × LCM: 12 × 924 ÷ 132 = 84. GPSC CBRT, Sep 2025.
Find the next number in the series: 1, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 13, ?
Each term is the sum of the two before it: 8 + 13 = 21.
If '+' means multiply, 'x' means subtract, '-' means divide and '/' means add, what is the value of 8 + 6 x 12 - 4 / 5?
Konkani is to Goa as Malayalam is to:
Konkani is the official language of Goa; Malayalam of Kerala.
The words Record, Recount, Receipt, Recall and Recent are arranged as in a dictionary. Which word comes third?
The order is Recall, Receipt, Recent, Record, Recount.
A's mother is the only daughter of B's father. If B is a man, how is B related to A?
B's father's only daughter is B's sister. She is A's mother, so B is A's maternal uncle.
Town P is 12 km due north of town Q. Town R is 5 km due west of P. What is the shortest distance between Q and R?
The two legs are at right angles: the square root of 144 + 25 = 169, which is 13 km.

Statement: Should the government ban plastic bags? Arguments: I. Yes, it will significantly reduce pollution and protect marine life. II. No, it will cause job losses in plastic manufacturing and inconvenience consumers.
Both I and II are strong
Both give a direct, serious consequence of the policy. GPSC CBRT, Jun 2025.
A petroleum product's price rises 25% every odd year and falls 20% every even year. After exactly 8 years the price has
× 1.25 × 0.8 = × 1 every two years, so after 8 years it is unchanged. GPSC CBRT, Jun 2025.
All X are Y. Some Y are Z. No Z is X. Which is true?
'No Z is X' turns round to 'No X is Z'. GPSC CBRT, Feb 2026.
Find the smallest number which leaves remainder 7 when divided by 12, 18, 21 or 30.
Find the next number in the series: 6, 11, 21, 36, 56, ?
ACE is to BDF as GIK is to:
Each letter moves one place forward: G-H, I-J, K-L.
In a certain language 'sun rises east' is written 'pa ko ti', 'east or west' is written 'ti la mu' and 'sun sets west' is written 'pa ru la'. Which word means 'rises'?
'pa' is sun (first and third phrases) and 'ti' is east (first and second), so the remaining word 'ko' is rises.
January, March and July have 31 days. June has 30.
M is the father of N. N is the sister of O. O is the husband of P. How is P related to M?
O is M's son and P is O's wife, so P is M's daughter-in-law.
A man is facing north. He turns right and walks 20 m, turns right again and walks 20 m, then turns left and walks 10 m. Which direction is he facing now?
North, then right to east, right to south, and left back to east.
A shoe showroom earns 25% profit after a 25% discount. What would the profit be with only a 10% discount?
Marked 100 → sells 75 = 1.25 × cost → cost 60. At 90: profit 30 on 60 = 50%. GPSC CBRT, Jun 2025.
Raju's age is 3 more than four times Balu's. In five years Raju will be 1 more than three times Balu's age. What is Raju's present age?
4B + 8 = 3(B + 5) + 1, so B = 8 and R = 35. GPSC CBRT, Jun 2025.

Statement: "The recent increase in crime is primarily due to a lack of adequate policing." Conclusions: 1. The government needs more police officers. 2. Crime is directly correlated with the number of police officers.
If policing is inadequate, more officers follows; a direct numerical correlation goes beyond the statement. GPSC CBRT, Mar 2025.
Choose the pair that best represents a similar relationship: FISH : SHOAL
A shoal is a group of fish; a pack is a group of wolves. GPSC CBRT, Sep 2025.
Find the next number in the series: 3, 5, 9, 17, 33, ?
Each term is double the previous one minus 1: 33 x 2 - 1 = 65.
Find the next letter in the series: Z, X, U, Q, L, ?
The steps back are 2, 3, 4, 5, then 6. L is the 12th letter, so the next is the 6th, F.
If OFFICE is written as PGGJDF in a certain code, how is TALUKA written?
Each letter moves one place forward: T-U, A-B, L-M, U-V, K-L, A-B.
Sarpanch is to Panchayat as Mayor is to:
A Sarpanch heads a Panchayat; a Mayor heads a Municipal Corporation.
Looking at a portrait, Arun said, 'I have no brother or sister, but this man's father is my father's son.' Whose portrait is it?
With no brother, 'my father's son' is Arun himself. So Arun is the father of the man in the portrait.
A river flows from east to west. It turns left, and then turns right. In which direction is it flowing now?
Flowing west, a left turn takes it south, and a right turn brings it back to west.
Statement: "If the train is delayed, I will be late." Which judgment follows?
If I am late, the train was delayed
The train causes all my lateness
I will be late if the train is delayed
Only the restatement is certain; A reverses the if-then. GPSC CBRT, Mar 2025.
April has 30 days. The ratio of rainy days to sunny days in April could NOT be
5 : 3 needs 8 parts; 30 is not a multiple of 8. The others split 30 exactly. GPSC CBRT, Mar 2025.

Statement: "Investing in renewable energy can reduce our carbon footprint." Argument A: Renewables are expensive to implement. Argument B: Renewables are key to reducing long-term environmental damage. Which is stronger?
B speaks directly to the statement's goal; cost alone does not answer it. GPSC CBRT, Mar 2025.
Find the next number in the series: 2, 6, 12, 20, 30, 42, ?
The terms are 1x2, 2x3, 3x4 and so on. The next is 7 x 8 = 56.
In the word PANCHAYAT, how many letters lie between the first A and the last A?
The first A is the 2nd letter and the last A is the 8th. Between them are N, C, H, A, Y: five letters.
In a certain code MONDAY is 6, TUESDAY is 7 and WEDNESDAY is 9. What is SATURDAY in that code?
Each word is coded by the number of letters in it. SATURDAY has 8.
The first three are appointed revenue officials. A Sarpanch is an elected head of a Panchayat.
A woman introduces a man as the son of her mother's brother. How is the man related to the woman?
Her mother's brother is her uncle, and his son is her cousin.
Sita's house faces south. She leaves by the back door, walks 50 m straight ahead, turns right and walks 30 m. In which direction is she walking now?
The back of the house faces north. She walks north, and a right turn takes her east.
Statement: "The company's profits have increased since the new advertising campaign." Which judgment is sound?
The rise is solely due to the campaign
The rise is unrelated to the campaign
The campaign may have contributed to the rise
Timing alone shows a possible link, not sole cause. GPSC CBRT, Mar 2025.
Numbers: 325 618 378 461 782 562 213. If the 1st and 3rd digits of each are interchanged, what is the sum of the product of the 1st and 3rd digits of the lowest number and that of the highest number?
New numbers: 523 816 873 164 287 265 312. Lowest 164 → 1 × 4 = 4; highest 873 → 8 × 3 = 24; total 28. GPSC CBRT, Mar 2025.
agnoscrenia = poisonous spider; delanocrenia = poisonous snake; agnosdeery = brown spider. Which word could mean "black widow spider"?
agnos = spider and comes first; the new word must start with agnos and use no known word. GPSC CBRT, Sep 2025.
The diagonal of a rectangle is 25 cm and one side is 24 cm. Find its area.
Other side √(625 − 576) = 7; area 24 × 7 = 168. GPSC CBRT, Sep 2025.
Find the next number in the series: 8, 27, 64, 125, ?
These are the cubes of 2, 3, 4 and 5. The next is 6 cubed, 216.
Which letter is exactly midway between G and S in the English alphabet?
G is the 7th letter and S the 19th. Midway is the 13th letter, M.
If CLERK is written as DMFSL in a certain code, how is JUDGE written?
Each letter moves one place forward: J-K, U-V, D-E, G-H, E-F.
Thermometer is to temperature as seismograph is to:
A seismograph records the ground movement caused by earthquakes.
Q and R are brother and sister. P is Q's son and S is R's son. How is P related to S?
The children of a brother and a sister are cousins.
Starting from point X, Raju walks 6 km north, then 8 km east, then 6 km south. How far is he from X?
The 6 km north and 6 km south cancel out, leaving him 8 km east of X.
A, B and C can do a work in 20, 30 and 60 days. In how many days can A do it if B and C help him every third day?
Per 3 days: 3/20 + 1/30 + 1/60 = 12/60 = 1/5 of the work, so 15 days. GPSC CBRT, Mar 2025.
Which word does NOT belong with the others?
The first three mean 'of little importance'. GPSC CBRT, Sep 2025.
Statement: "The government should immediately tighten regulation of pharmaceutical advertising to protect public health." Which assumption is inherent?
Such advertising now misleads the public or poses a health risk
Regulation is the only way to protect public health
The government has all the resources needed
Public health is deteriorating because of such advertising
The call for urgent regulation presumes a present risk. B and D are too strong. GPSC CBRT, Jun 2025.
Each term is n × (n + 1) of the previous: 1806 × 1807 = 3263442. GPSC CBRT, Jun 2025.
Statement: Sales of a product have fallen sharply. Courses of action: I. Study rival products in the market. II. Cut the price and improve quality.
Study comes first; II prescribes a remedy before the cause is known. GPSC CBRT, Dec 2024.
Parents have complained of bullying during recess. Which situation should the recess aides report to the principal?
Four girls surround another and hold her backpack
Two boys argue over a basketball score
Three boys play a banned video game
Only B shows a group intimidating one child. GPSC CBRT, Dec 2024.
A Five-Day Suspension is for (1) physically assaulting someone or (2) wilfully damaging or defacing school property. Which is the best example?
Lillian is caught cheating a second time
Marc is sent out for disruptions
Franny spray-paints insults on the locker-room wall and is suspended
Failing students must stay for tutoring
Defacing school property meets condition (2). GPSC CBRT, Sep 2024.
A town's population grew from 1,75,000 to 2,62,500 in a decade. What was the average per cent increase per year?
Increase 87,500 = 50% over 10 years: 5% a year on average (simple). GPSC CBRT, Sep 2024.

Should trade unions be banned completely? I. Yes, workers can concentrate on production. II. No, it is the only way employees can put demands to management. III. Yes, unions get illegal demands met. IV. No, advanced countries don't ban them.
Only I and II are strong
Only I, II and III are strong
II gives a real, important reason. I and III are weak generalisations; IV just copies others. GPSC CBRT, Sep 2024.

Rainfall in the catchment was below normal for two months, yet the city's water supply has not been cut. Assumptions: I. Rainfall later in the monsoon may be adequate. II. Present lake levels may be adequate for normal supply.
Either I or II is implicit
Not cutting supply assumes enough water now and the hope of more later. GPSC CBRT, Sep 2025.
What day of the week was 15 August 1947?
Independence Day 1947 fell on a Friday. GPSC CBRT, Sep 2025.
Sara lives in a large East Coast city. Her younger cousin Marlee lives in a small Mid-west town. Marlee has visited Sara several times in five years; Sara has visited Marlee once. Which must be true?
Marlee is the younger cousin, so Sara is older. The rest is speculation. GPSC CBRT, Sep 2025.
Statement: Schools have multiplied, but most are ill-equipped and not excellent. Conclusions: I. We should give these schools good teachers and equipment. II. We need not open more schools.
The problem stated is quality, which I addresses; II goes beyond the statement. GPSC CBRT, Sep 2025.
At what time between 4 and 5 o’clock will the hands of the clock be together?
5.5M = 120, so M = 21 9/11 min ≈ 21 min 49 s. GPSC CBRT, Sep 2025.
Gauri bought things worth ₹25, of which 30 paise was sales tax at 6% on taxable items. What was the cost of the tax-free items?
Taxable items: 0.30 ÷ 0.06 = ₹5. Tax-free = 25 − 5 − 0.30 = ₹19.70. GPSC CBRT, Sep 2024.
From a point P on level ground, the top of a 100 m tower is at an elevation of 30°. How far is P from the foot of the tower?
What is the profit per cent on an article? I. 5% discount is given on the list price. II. Without the discount, the profit would be 20%. III. The cost price is ₹5,000. Which statements are necessary?
List = 1.2 × cost, sold at 0.95 × list = 1.14 × cost: 14% profit. The cost figure isn't needed. GPSC CBRT, Apr 2024.
The present ages of Sameer and Anand are in the ratio 5 : 4. Three years hence it will be 11 : 9. What is Anand's present age?
9(5x + 3) = 11(4x + 3), so x = 6 and Anand = 24. GPSC CBRT, Apr 2024.
If P means +, Q means −, R means × and S means ÷, what is 8 R 2 S 4 Q 6 P 2?
Consecutive primes: next is 19. GPSC CBRT, Jun 2025.
Which does not belong? Jurisprudence, Criminology, Penology, Entomology
Entomology is the study of insects; the rest concern law and crime. GPSC CBRT, Jun 2025.
If BEAUTY is coded as DHEZZF, how is FLOWER written?
Shifts +2, +3, +4, +5, +6, +7 (wrapping round): F→H, L→O, O→S, W→B, E→K, R→Y. GPSC CBRT, Jun 2025.
× 2 + 1, × 2 − 1 by turns: 99 × 2 − 1 = 197, not 187. GPSC CBRT, Jun 2025.
Rohan is 21st from the top and 15th from the bottom of his class. How many students are there?
The banker's gain on a sum due 2 years hence at 10% a year is ₹24. What is the present worth?
BG = TD × RT/100, so TD = 24 × 100 ÷ 20 = 120; PW = TD × 100 ÷ RT = 600. GPSC CBRT, Apr 2024.
A train chugs; a door bangs (the sound each makes). GPSC CBRT, Apr 2024.
Is the average age of a school's students less than 17? I. Class VIII is under 25% of the school. II. Class VIII averages 18 years; the rest average 16.
II alone allows any average between 16 and 18. With I, the weight of 18 is under 25%, so the average is below 16.5. GPSC CBRT, Apr 2024.
The speeds of a train and a man are 6 : 1. The 650 m train passes a pole in 1 minute 5 seconds. How long will the man take to cross a 240 m platform?
Amit, Anil and Ajit ride the same distance at speeds 5 : 4 : 3, taking 94 minutes in total. How long does Anil take?
Times are in the ratio 1/5 : 1/4 : 1/3 = 12 : 15 : 20; 94 ÷ 47 = 2, so Anil 30 min. GPSC CBRT, Apr 2024.
In how many ways can the letters of the word LOGICAL be arranged?
7 letters with L twice: 7!/2! = 2520, not listed. GPSC's key said 5040, which ignores the repeated L. GPSC CBRT, Jun 2025.
In how many ways can the letters of PENCIL be arranged so that the vowels are always together?
Treat E, I as one block: 5! × 2! = 240. GPSC CBRT, Jun 2025.
The others contain only vowels. GPSC CBRT, Jun 2025.
Jonathan passes a church one-fifth of the way to the stadium at 6.05 pm and a farm one-third of the way at 6.15 pm. When does he reach the stadium?
1/3 − 1/5 = 2/15 of the way in 10 min, so the whole trip is 75 min. 4/5 left at 6.05 = 60 min: 7.05 pm. GPSC CBRT, Jun 2025.

Should competitive examinations for professional courses be fully online? I. Yes, less printing and transport, faster results. II. No, it disadvantages rural and low-income students without reliable internet.
Both give real, relevant consequences. GPSC CBRT, Jun 2025.
Today is Monday. After 61 days it will be:
